params.name: selector
params.description: Which Web server setting to modify.

params.name: value
params.description: New value for the selected option; accepted shape depends entirely on selector -- see discriminatedBy. Confirmed missing from the original draft by the LSP cross-check (tool4d rejected a selector-only call site with a parameter-count/type mismatch) and against the real doc syntax example "WEB SET OPTION(Web debug log;wdl enable without body)", which always passes two arguments.

overloads.semanticRole: The WEB SET OPTION command modifies the current value of various options concerning the functioning of the 4D Web server.

discriminatedBy.rule: value's accepted type/range is selected by which WebServerOptionSelector constant is passed in selector; see each enum entry's description for its expected value shape. When selector is 'Web debug log', value is one of the WebDebugLogLevel enum constants.

constraints: selector selects which Web server setting is modified (see the WebServerOptionSelector enum), and the accepted shape/range of value depends entirely on which selector is passed: most are Integer or Boolean-as-Integer, Web IP address to listen/Web Client IP address to listen/Web session cookie name/domain/path are Text, Web CORS settings is a Collection of CORS objects, and Web debug log's value is drawn from the WebDebugLogLevel sub-enum.
Changes made via this command persist across Web server stop/restart but are lost when the 4D application itself is restarted.
Several selectors (e.g. Web scalable session, Web HSTS enabled) require a Web server restart to take effect; others apply immediately.
